verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an official MCP server with a dedicated setup page. It runs as a stdio server that AI tools such as Claude and Cursor launch directly, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: detail on which tools and operations the server exposes, any hosted/remote (non-stdio) option, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This MCP server implements the `stdio` server type, which means your AI tool (e.g. Claude, Cursor) will run it directly
An MCP server is a component of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which is an open standard for connecting AI systems with external data sources and tools.
